items.name: User Dashboard
items.description: AssemblyAI's user account dashboard allows users to view and manage their account information, find helpful resources, and try things out in the Playground. Each core AAI product comes with its own unique Playground. Over the course of my time at Assembly, I contributed to multiple refactors, redesigns, and new feature launches that touched nearly all of the dashboard's functions.

items.name: Onboarding Configuration Wizard
items.description: I led the development of the configuration wizard, a feature of the authenticated experience, guides user's through a simple onboarding process that provides new users with resources and recipes that match their exact use case. Each recipe is integrated with and selectable in the Playground as presets.

items.name: Usage Management
items.description: I drove the front-end development of the pages where users can manage their product usage and cost. In addition, on the back-end I managed the flow of data between Metronome, our provider for billing management, and the dashboard through an Account Management Service suite of APIs.

items.name: Skills Navigator Workforce Hubs
items.description: A set of modular career hubs that provide students and young adults with tools to explore career options in their local communities. Each hub comes with a custom-tailored pathways experience that begins with a short quiz.

items.name: Leader Profiles
items.description: At Roadtrip Nation, we've built an archive of over 8,000 interviews with unique leaders across the US, each detailing a one of a kind career journey. I spearheaded implementation of a new, modern, design that showcases these leaders.

items.name: Roadtrip Nation Experience Course
items.description: An in-depth, classroom-based immersive for students and educators. This course guides students through a reflection on their own skills and connects those with career options and real-world stories from the Roadtrip Nation interview archive.
